data.name: Raashid
data.gender_notes: Raashid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who walks on the straight path, rightly guided by Allah. The name Raashid carries the meaning “Rightly Guided” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Raashid usually hope their child will grow to embody rightly guided and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Walking on the straight path, Raashid is a soulful reminder of the divine guidance that leads to righteousness.
data.etymology: Raashid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rightly Guided.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raashid total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: راشد
in_arabic.meaning: من يهدي الله فلا ضل له ومن يضلل فلا هادي له
in_arabic.long_meaning: راشد هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني من يهدي الله فلا ضل له ومن يضلل فلا هادي له، وهو اسم الفاعل من هدى، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يمشي على الطريق المستقيم ويتبع الهداية الإلهية. ورد اسم راشد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلِهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدُونِي' (الأنبياء: 25)، وقد ذكر اسم راشد في الحديث النبوي الشريف: 'مَنْ سَلِمَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَضَرَّاتِهِ فَقَدْ أُتِيَ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ النِّعَمِ، وَمَنْ هُدِيَ لِلصَّوَابِ فَقَدْ رُشِدَ'.

in_urdu.name: راشد
in_urdu.meaning: جو شخص سیدھے راستے پر چلتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: راشد کا مطلب ہے جو شخص سیدھے راستے پر چلتا ہے اور الہی ہدایت کی پیروی کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے 'من يهدي الله فلا ضل له ومن يضلل فلا هادي له'۔ اسلامی تقليد میں راشد ایک اہم نام ہے کیونکہ یہ شخص کی صحیح راہ پر چلنے کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: राशिद
in_hindi.meaning: जो सही रास्ते पर चलता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: राशिद नाम का अर्थ है जो सही रास्ते पर चलता है और ईश्वरीय मार्गदर्शन का पालन करता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह व्यक्ति की सच्चाई और नेक मार्ग पर चलने की विशेषता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: راشد
in_pashto.meaning: چا په سمه لاره روان وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: راشد د دې معنی دی چې څوک په سمه لاره روان وي او د الهي هدايت په لاره کې وي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او په اسلامي دود کې ډير اهميت لري ځکه چې دا د شخص د صداقت او د نيکې لارې د تعقيب ځانګړتیا څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Raashid
in_english.meaning: One who walks on the right path
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raashid is derived from the Arabic root 'r-sh-d', which means 'to guide' or 'to direct'. It refers to someone who is guided by Allah and walks on the right path. The name Raashid is mentioned in the Quran and Hadith, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. The name symbolizes righteousness, guidance, and adherence to the true path.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Raashid" carries a profound cultural impact in Arabic-speaking communities. It is a name that signifies a strong connection to one's Islamic faith and a commitment to living a virtuous and moral life according to the teachings of the Quran. The name is often associated with honor, respect, and good character. Many parents choose to name their children Raashid as a source of inspiration and as a reminder of the importance of staying on the straight path in life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Raashid" is a reminder of Allah's guidance and mercy. It is a name that reflects one's desire to live a life pleasing to Allah and to seek His forgiveness and guidance at every turn. The name is a constant reminder of the importance of staying connected to Allah and of striving to live in accordance with His laws and teachings. It is a source of inspiration and strength for those who bear the name, reminding them of their ultimate goal in life: to please Allah and to seek His acceptance in the Hereafter.
